parameters.help_en: The VPC NAT gateway ID for NAT mapping. If specified, NAT mapping is enabled when the instance is created. The NAT gateway must be in the same VPC as the application, use the private network type (intranet), and be in an active state
parameters.help_zh: NAT映射：客户自建的VPC NAT网关ID，传入则在创建实例时一并开通NAT映射。须与应用同VPC、私网类型（intranet）、可用状态
parameters.name: vpc_nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The DNAT-dedicated NAT IP address that has been allocated (separate from the SNAT IP address) for NAT mapping. The IP address must belong to the specified gateway and be in an available state. The vSwitch of the gateway must belong to a primary CIDR block that is reachable from the office network. Specify this parameter together with VpcNatGatewayId. Prerequisite: An SNAT entry has been bound to the vSwitch where the application resides
parameters.help_zh: NAT映射：客户已分配的DNAT专用NAT IP地址（与SNAT IP分离）。须属于该网关、可用状态，且网关所在交换机属于办公网可达的主网段。与VpcNatGatewayId同时传入。前置条件：客户已为应用所在交换机绑定SNAT条目
parameters.name: dnat_ip_address

fields.help_en: The frontend port. This parameter is optional. If not specified, the system automatically assigns a port that does not conflict with ports already in use on the gateway. You can query the assignment result by calling the DescribeApplicationAttribute operation
fields.help_zh: 前端端口，可选。缺省由管控自动分配（避开网关已占端口），分配结果可通过DescribeApplicationAttribute查询
fields.name: front_port

fields.help_en: The port name. Valid values: webui, hermesagent, dashboard, and ssh
fields.help_zh: 端口名称，取值：webui | hermesagent | dashboard | ssh
fields.name: port_name

parameters.help_en: The list of expected DNAT entries for NAT mapping. Specify this parameter together with VpcNatGatewayId. This parameter can be left empty, which indicates that no DNAT entries are created
parameters.help_zh: NAT映射：DNAT条目期望清单，与VpcNatGatewayId同时传入。可为空，表示不创建DNAT条目
parameters.name: dnat_entries
